subject: islamic-religious-education
general_outcomes: Recite, read and write the selected surah to enhance interaction with the Qur’an as a primary source of guidance.
Deduce lessons from the selected surah and apply them in daily life.

Respect: acceptance as learners discuss lessons learnt from the events of fath-ul Makkah
